#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Make the test api server to use its own  `ComponentGlobalsRegistry` instead of the `DefaultComponentGlobalsRegistry` to avoid contention. 

When `--emulated-version` is set in api server, it would change the enabled features in the feature gate, which is not protected by any lock. It is better to set a proxy feature gate in the test api server first, and later copy the values over to the `DefaultFeatureGate` through `SetFeatureGateDuringTest`.

issue_context.title: `kubeapiservertesting.StartTestServer` mutates global state and prevents parallel tests within the same package
issue_context.body:
The following recent changes make it hard to run parallel integration tests from within the same package (the `utilruntime.Must` call will occasionally `panic`):

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/632ed16e002d87fa7166a8f4ca1dc48d4f0a9725/cmd/kube-apiserver/app/testing/testserver.go#L196-L208

This can be hacked around but adding locks (though I suspect that does not cover all cases):

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/632ed16e002d87fa7166a8f4ca1dc48d4f0a9725/test/integration/controlplane/transformation/transformation_test.go#L151-L158

Note that while many integration tests cannot be run in parallel because the test logic itself mutates global state, the base `kubeapiservertesting.StartTestServer` should support running parallel tests for the cases in which the test logic itself does not need to mutate global state.

cc @deads2k @jpbetz @liggitt 

/sig api-machinery
/triage accepted

review_comments: re feature gates via flags: Is this only necessary for changing feature gates while emulating a previous version or are we eventually going to use this format for all feature gate changes in integration tests?

Ideally I would like all feature gate changes go through the flag.  But that is not feasible when testing multiple components like with scheduler, so `SetFeatureGateDuringTest` will stay. So using the flags is really necessary for changing feature gates while emulating a previous version. Other cases, `SetFeatureGateDuringTest` is probably fine.
